method: 432 synchronized GPU-finish/readback software renders, 960x640 DPR1; 3 profiles × 3 scenes × 4 variants × 3 alternating rounds × 4 samples. Same camera/sun/wind/date and explicit common snowy-light vector (cloud .96, mist .30, wind .38, rain 0) reproduced in every variant, including 15A diagnostic weather object; snow emission only in the snowfall variant. Common conditions asserted for every variant; weather labels remain Overcast because the diagnostic vector is held, not a new normal-user mode. Held deterministic simulation; no other browser/GPU workload. No GPU/Android FPS claim.
